label: Both ADECE and Melissa coords missing
description: Neither ADECE (latitude/longitude) nor Melissa (LAT/LNG) coordinates are available. Hard fail because the row contributes no usable geometry to the master table.
policy_notes: Hard-block in geocode_validate(); cannot reconcile. Never observed in v0.8.0 - included as defensive contract guard.

label: Both present, exact agreement (<10m)
description: Both ADECE and Melissa coordinates present and haversine distance is below 10m. Reconciler accepts melissa as authoritative.
policy_notes: Pass-through; band='exact'. Melissa wins per default authoritative_priority='melissa_first'.

label: Both present, tight agreement (10-100m)
description: Both coordinates present, distance 10-100m. Typical for GS05 Rooftop vs ADECE street-level entry; well within rooftop expected accuracy (~90m).
policy_notes: Pass-through; band='tight'. Median of v0.8.0 distribution sits here (overall median 102m).

label: Both present, loose agreement (100m-1km)
description: Both coordinates present, distance 100m-1km. Within precision tier of GS06 Interpolated Rooftop (128m median) and acceptable GS01 Zip+4 spread.
policy_notes: Reconciler still accepts melissa; band='loose'; logged for diagnostic distribution but no manual review required.

label: Both present, drift (1-10km)
description: Both coordinates present, distance 1-10km. Suggests ADECE address coarseness or normalization artifact. Acceptable for GS03 ZIP5 Community Centroid (4001m median), suspicious for GS05/GS06.
policy_notes: Band='drift'; melissa wins but needs_followup=TRUE so analyst can verify the ADECE address.

label: Both present, gross outlier (>=10km)
description: Both coordinates present, distance >= 10km. Bryan Elementary (57km) and Loachapoka (37km) class. Almost certainly an ADECE address-entry error carried across years.
policy_notes: Band='gross'. lat_source flagged 'disputed_melissa' so master_geocode preserves both coords for forensic review. Priority queue entry.

label: ADECE missing, Melissa present, acceptable RESULTCODE (rooftop/Zip+4)
description: ADECE coords missing but Melissa supplied a high-precision geocode (GS05 Rooftop / GS01 Zip+4 Street Level). This is the rescue path - Melissa fills the gap with credible accuracy.
policy_notes: Standard rescue path; band='melissa_rescue'. Covers majority of the 184 ADECE-missing rows.

label: ADECE missing, Melissa present, low-precision RESULTCODE (centroid/interpolated)
description: ADECE coords missing and Melissa returned a low-precision geocode (GS03 ZIP5 centroid or GS06 Interpolated Rooftop). Master accepts melissa but flags for follow-up so an exact address can be obtained.
policy_notes: Rescue path but flagged. Covers the residual ADECE-missing rows where Melissa precision is suspect.

label: ADECE present, Melissa missing
description: Melissa LAT/LNG missing even though geocode_address was sent. Violates the Melissa delivery contract (LAT/LNG always present in v0.8.0). Hard fail.
policy_notes: Hard-block; geocode_validate() raises. Never observed in v0.8.0; signals vendor contract violation in a future delivery.

label: site_code missing (new rows)
description: ADECE row lacks site_code - these are the 108 _new rows in the 2025-2026_new school_year cohort. row_id pattern is '{YYYY-YYYY}_new_NNNN' instead of '{YYYY-YYYY}_{site_code}'.
policy_notes: Allowed by config (is_required=FALSE). Master keeps the row; needs_followup=TRUE so site_code is assigned downstream once ADECE confirms.

label: ADECE coord outside Alabama bounds
description: ADECE latitude/longitude falls outside AL bounds (lat 30-36, lng -89 to -84). Suggests data entry error (transposed lat/lng, missing negative sign, etc.).
detection_rule: !is.na(latitude) & (latitude < cfg$al_lat_bounds[1] | latitude > cfg$al_lat_bounds[2] | longitude < cfg$al_lng_bounds[1] | longitude > cfg$al_lng_bounds[2])
policy_notes: Reconciler prefers melissa; band='adece_oob'. Theoretical / forward-compat - not observed in v0.8.0.

label: Melissa coord outside Alabama bounds
description: Melissa LAT/LNG falls outside AL bounds. Implies a vendor mis-geocode (wrong state, parsing failure) and disqualifies the melissa coord from master.
detection_rule: !is.na(LAT_num) & (LAT_num < cfg$al_lat_bounds[1] | LAT_num > cfg$al_lat_bounds[2] | LNG_num < cfg$al_lng_bounds[1] | LNG_num > cfg$al_lng_bounds[2])
policy_notes: Hard-flag; reconciler falls back to ADECE if present, else 'none'. Forward-compat guard.

label: RESULTCODE outside documented set
description: Melissa RESULTCODE value not in {GS01..GS08}. Forward-compatibility guard for new Melissa precision tiers.
policy_notes: Reconciler treats unknown code conservatively (acts like GS03). v0.8.0 observed only GS01/GS03/GS05/GS06.

label: has_latlon TRUE but latitude is NA
description: Logical-consistency violation: has_latlon must equal !is.na(latitude). Indicates upstream clean step or ADECE export corruption.

label: row_id duplicate
description: Two or more rows share an identical row_id. row_id is the primary join key to ADECE classrooms; duplicates corrupt the master join.
policy_notes: Hard-block; geocode_validate() raises. v0.8.0 row_id is 100% unique (3396 distinct).

label: ADECE county does not match Melissa COUNTYNAME
description: ADECE-recorded county disagrees with Melissa-resolved COUNTYNAME for the same row. Examples: Loachapoka (ADECE Chambers vs Melissa Lee), Samson (ADECE Coffee vs Melissa Geneva). Strong signal of ADECE address-entry error.
policy_notes: Co-occurs with G06 in real data. Reconciler keeps melissa but marks lat_source='disputed_melissa' and needs_followup=TRUE. Surfaces ADECE county metadata correction queue.

label: Persistent multi-year outlier (3+ years, identical distance)
description: Same site_code shows an identical ADECE-Melissa distance across 3 or more school_years. Confirms the discrepancy is a stable ADECE source-data issue, not coordinate drift.
detection_rule: Group by site_code; n_distinct(round(dist_m, 0)) == 1 & n_distinct(school_year) >= 3 & max(dist_m) > 1000
policy_notes: Diagnostic / priority queue marker. Detected in the validator's panel-level pass, not per-row. 11 sites in v0.8.0 top-50 outliers.

label: Surprising GS05 outlier (rooftop > 5km)
description: RESULTCODE GS05 (Rooftop) but ADECE-Melissa distance > 5km. GS05 should be sub-100m; large distance implies ADECE address-error rather than Melissa precision issue.
policy_notes: More informative than G06 alone: signals ADECE address is wrong (since GS05 Rooftop is high-precision). 21 rows in v0.8.0 (0.8% of GS05).
